title: Construct the reserve and center response of a fixed affine-query program
statement: For fixed-coefficient queries q_i=u_i+b_i x+sum_(j<i)a_ij g(q_j)+sum_k B_ikZ_k and output Y=cx+v+sum f_jg(q_j)+DZ,assume b is in range B. Put U=bx+BZ,P=Bdagger B,a=c-DBdagger b,R=D(I-P)D^T. Then Y=ax+Psi(U)+N(0,R tensor I),with independent constructed reserve. If R>0,a zero-output center gauge orthogonal to this reserve exists exactly when a=0.

requires: Known coefficients independent of x,seeds and source values
Finite affine-query program;source-dependent branches/nonlinear coefficients excluded
Rank and range conditions certified in the declared arithmetic model
provides: Each physical query and returned SOURCE value is a function of U by induction
Minimum-norm query-preserving gauge -Bdagger b and explicit query-free output response
Known affine-response subtraction and alternate unused-slot repair with explicit covariance/precision costs
assumptions: The full final output also contains ax and reserve;it is not wholly a function of U
Source-specific extra cancellations may yield other reserves
Subtracting ax may worsen child Lipschitz/noise budgets
costs: Known finite linear algebra,polynomial in queries/seed/output slots;no g calls to compute metadata
Finite precision requires rank/conditioning margins and output-error budget
Factor2 reserve loss at a generic orthogonality repair is not free
contract.units: Pathwise Gaussian-seed metadata and original values
contract.obstruction: A usable conditional representation,not favorable universal reserve/gauge growth or general recursive query complexity.

evidence.quote: every q_i and returned source value
evidence.range_scope: Fixed affine-query normal form,constructed reserve and compatible response;final output need not be a function of query-visible U.
